sentences.text: Case :- Criminal Misc. Bail Application No. - 10754 of 2023

Applicant :- Sameer Khan And Another
Opposite Party :- State of U.P.
Counsel for Applicant :- Lakshman Tripathi,Aniruddha Ojha

Counsel for Opposite Party :- G.A.
Hon'ble Sameer Jain,J.
Heard Sri Lakshman Tripathi, learned counsel for the applicant and Dr. S. B. Maurya, learned AGA-I for the State-respondent.

The instant application has been filed seeking release of the applicant on bail in Case Crime No. 301 of 2022, under Sections 188, 273 IPC & 5/15 of Environment (Protection) Act, 1986 & 3/63 of Food Safety and Standard Authority Act, 2006, Police Station Sigra, District Varanasi, during pendency of the trial in the court below.

entities.text: Food Safety and Standard Authority Act, 2006
entities.label: STATUTE

sentences.text:
FIR of the present case was lodged against the applicant and two others and according to the FIR,
from the possession of the applicant and other co-accused persons 10 quintal prohibited thai mangur fish was recovered.

Learned counsel for the applicant submitted that although entire allegations made against the applicant are totally false and baseless but even if entire allegations are accepted then also as there is no allegation of any adulteration, therefore, implication of the applicant under section 272 IPC is bad.
It is further submitted that as far as offences under section 188 IPC and offences under the provisions of Food Safety Acts are concerned both are non cognizable offences.

He further Sameer Khan And Another vs State Of U.P. on 27 March, 2023 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/156936203/
1 submitted that applicants are having no criminal history and they are in jail in the present matter since 28.12.2022, therefore, they may be released on bail.

entities.text: Sameer Khan And Another vs State Of U.P.
entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text: Per contra, learned AGA opposed the prayer for bail but could not dispute the fact that there is no allegation against the applicants that they adulterated any food item and only allegation against them is that from their possession thai mangur fish was recovered which was prohibited one.
I have heard learned counsel for the parties and perused the record of the case.

From the perusal of the record, it appears that applicants were challened under sections 188/273 IPC, 5/15 Environment (Protection) Act, 1986 and 3/63 of Food Safety and Standard Authority Act and as per allegation, from the possession of the applicant and two others, 10 quintal prohibited thai mungra fish was recovered and there is no allegation that they adulterated the alleged recovered fish.

entities.text: Food Safety and Standard Authority Act
entities.label: STATUTE

sentences.text: Further offences, under section 188 IPC and under the provision of Food Safety Act, are non cognizable.
Applicants are having no previous criminal history apart from the present case.
Therefore, from the discussions made above, in my view, applicant is entitled to be released on bail.
Accordingly, without expressing any opinion on the merits of the case, the instant bail application is allowed.

Let the applicants-Sameer Khan and Safi Khan, be released on bail in the aforesaid case on furnishing a personal bond and two sureties each in the like amount to the satisfaction of the court concerned with the following conditions:-
(i) The applicants shall appear before the trial court on the dates fixed, unless their personal presence is exempted.

(ii) The applicants shall not directly or indirectly, make inducement, threat or promise to any person acquainted with the facts of the case so as to dissuade them from disclosing such facts to the Court or any police officer or tamper with the evidence.
(iii) The applicants shall not indulge in any criminal and anti-social activity.
In case of breach of any of the above condition, the prosecution will be at liberty to move an application before this Court for cancellation of the bail of the applicants.

Order Date :- 27.3.2023 Ankita  Sameer Khan And Another vs State Of U.P. on 27 March, 2023 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/156936203/
